explanation: Backtrack through the b-dimensional bit cube, beginning at zero and trying one-bit flips. Keep a visited set to avoid repeated values and accept a full path only when its last value also differs from the first in one bit.
timeComplexity: Backtracking upper bound O((b+1)^(2^b)); each accepted answer contains 2^b values.
spaceComplexity: O(2^b) visited, path and recursion space.
